strength_curve._description: Non-linear amplification of rating differences. 1.0 = linear.

star_player_weights._description: Weighted positional influence within each line. Sum to 1.0 per line.

national_modifier._description: Captures coaching, system, mentality not reflected in player ratings.

_v5_goal_rate_scale_note: Fitted once: pooled mean goals / V4 tactical lambda = 0.972 over 12 PL fixtures at 150 sims each (V5, pre-calibration). Scale = 1/0.972. Re-fit if the phase modifiers change.
